title: SquareHare
description: This resource pack simply adds a square crosshair
body:
**Square Crosshair – v26.1 Alpha**

A lightweight, modern resource pack that replaces the default Minecraft crosshair with a clean, minimal square design. Built for clarity, precision, and smoother PvP or survival gameplay, this pack works on all Minecraft versions **1.21 and above**. The square crosshair offers improved visibility without cluttering your screen, making it ideal for players who want a sharper, more consistent aiming experience. Fully compatible with **shaders**, **modded clients**, and **vanilla gameplay**.
